entries.body: Stages1-3 done in invoice/core.py: r2, _validate, tier_rate, tax_rate(10%), compute_invoice: amounts (bulk qty>=100 x0.90 before round), subtotal, discounts list [tier*subtotal], discount=sum r2, shipping 7.50 if subtotal-discount<100 else 0 (line 25), tax=r2((subtotal-discount)*rate), total. Returns str dict subtotal/discount/shipping/tax/total. Read stage files for reqs.
